inlineCode: // ПІСЛЯСВІТ 0.8.4j · 0.6.6 — CHARACTER POLISH: gameplay preserved from 0.5; environment and audio are decorative
// Uses the integrated watercolor level art from v0.4; only visual presentation is refined.
Pure physics/light/stealth simulation: frame-rate-independent, no engine calls.
Player position is feet-center; x/y values use original prototype world units.
hint:'A/D — рух · SPACE — стрибок · S — тихо · X — ривок.',
s.hint='Спалах згас. Тепер спробуй пройти обережніше.';
// Buffer jump press so pressing before landing is forgiving.
// A released jump shortens the rise, without changing the initial impulse.
// Dash is an edge-triggered burst with a definite duration/cooldown.
// Locked gate is a real wall, not just a graphic.
// Light is continuous, not a boolean; sneaking has a lower target because
// movement is slower. Dash and jumping briefly produce an optical pulse.
// The crab is a first test creature: footsteps trigger vibrations, while
// strong light can betray the player even if nearly motionless.
// Kelp camouflage: when dark and crouched, the crab cannot catch Spalakh.
// 0.8.4i LIGHT READOUT: react to Spalakh's actual brightness, not mere proximity.
// Charge lasts about 0.52 s under sustained bright motion; dash light lingers briefly.
// The sensor clearly displays OFF (red), SCAN (amber blinking), ON (green).
s.hint='СЕНСОР АКТИВОВАНО · ЗЕЛЕНИЙ СИГНАЛ! Далі краб.';
// Checkpoint after opening the sensor, before the crab. The player does not
// need to replay the introduction after a failed stealth attempt.
s.hint='Перший сигнал знайдено! Відпусти SPACE та натисни ще раз, щоб спуститися в Глибину.';
// Stage progression; hint priority follows the current gameplay objective.
if(s.gateBlocked)s.hint='Шлюз замкнений. Повернись до світлового сенсора.';
else if(s.crabState==='chase' && s.x>1330 && s.x<1980)s.hint='КРАБ ПОМІТИВ СВІТЛО! Сховайся або тікай.';
else if(s.stage===0)s.hint='A/D — рух · SPACE — стрибок · S — тихо · X — ривок.';

else if(s.stage===1)s.hint=s.sensorScanState==='SCAN'?('СЕНСОР ЗЧИТУЄ СЯЙВО · '+Math.round(s.sensorProgress/.52*100)+'% · НЕ ЗГАСАЙ'):('СЕНСОР ЧЕРВОНИЙ · ПІДБІЖИ АБО ЗРОБИ РИВОК X, ЩОБ ЙОГО ОСВІТИТИ');
else if(s.stage===2)s.hint='Завмри, щоб згаснути. Потім S — тихо крізь водорості повз краба.';
else if(s.stage===3)s.hint='Шлюз відкритий. Рухайся до аварійного буя.';
else s.hint='Підійди до буя. Сигнал може привести до джерела світла.';
// v0.6: atmosphere state is independent of the saved gameplay state.
// Visual polish: collision platforms stay for physics, but become invisible in the scene.
// Push the existing watercolor harbor backdrop into depth, without repainting the original image.
// Secondary props sit below the foreground focal point in value/contrast.
// Snapshot the existing game state. No physics/collision/detection values are touched.
// 0.2 light motion: independent inertia, slower dimming than ignition.
// No body-size oscillation. Only flame-tendril pixels change across frames.
// Animation priority: dash / aerial / land / sneak / run / walk / idle.
// Only switch animation when the state changes: do not restart it on every tick.
// 0.8.4e: feet are y242 in EVERY normalised RGBA frame, on the 384x256 canvas.
// Render position does not change with animation; logical collision foot = a.y.
// v0.8.0: exactly ~4 seconds to dim after stillness, then subtle breathing light.
// Body tint/opacity only: no change to brightness, physics, sensor logic or stealth.
// The very subtle 3.6s pulse starts only AFTER reaching the final resting opacity.
// Body width fixed: no pulsating scale.
// Body height fixed: no bobbing or squash/stretch of the entire creature.
// Player halo: centered near the yellow glowing head rather than at the feet.
// Worldlight and pool are soft, painterly light-projections. They illuminate
// watercolor visually without requiring fragile shader/lighting extensions.
// Highlights on platforms: falloff with distance to the light being.
// Art feet = AI ground y616; use fixed sprite dimensions 215x131, independent of AI hitbox.
// 0.8.0 — SOFT BODY COMET: 40px diffused bloom, body-attached origin and feathered leading edge.
// Procedural PIXI ribbon; no PNGs, particle emitters, smoke blobs or gameplay side effects.
function updateSoftComet0794(runtimeScene, actor, dt, deathCount, dying, won, reset, behindZ) {
// Wide gaussian bloom ≈40px around the broad ribbon; enough padding prevents hard clipping.
// Keep the ribbon sharp and graphic: only soft and aura get blur.
// Strong gold/orange core sits inside a soft crimson halo.
} catch (noFilter) { /* Works without a blur filter. */ }
// Feet-center gameplay pivot. This emitter is behind the WHOLE sprite body:
// center y -78 with a half-span up to 72px at dash = head, wings, torso and feet.
// Start INSIDE the player body (in front of the feet pivot), where the sprite hides the cap.
// A feathered leading edge eliminates the visible rectangular cut seen in v0.7.9.3.
// Do not connect two places when respawning or teleporting.
// Interpolated trajectory follows direction changes instead of drawing straight lasers.
// Colors progress from pale yellow at the WHOLE BODY to orange and deep crimson at the tip.
// Keep the cross section oriented consistently through reversals/loops.
// Newest segment fades in BELOW the body instead of ending in a sharp vertical slab.
// The broad shoulder covers 100–145 px of character silhouette, then narrows to a tip.
// No circular sprites: every band is a continuous tapered mesh.
// From diffuse outer bloom to dense gold core. Bands share identical broad geometry.
// Visuals must never be able to stop gameplay.
// 0.8.4e — pixel sparks: 5 crisp RED squares at each jump/dash, born at the TRAIL TIP.
// Physical positions independent of the player. Pixelated on purpose (NO blur/filter).
// The first/oldest still-visible trail sample is its detached far tip.
// Only physically opaque objects affect sparks; non-interactive glows are ignored.
// 0.8.4i optical feedback, anchored to the physical light-sensitive lens.
// Do NOT call setScale: it resets custom-size using source pixels (640x640).
const stageTitles=['01/05 · ПРОБУДЖЕННЯ','02/05 · СЕНСОР','03/05 · ТИХА ЗОНА','04/05 · ШЛЮЗ','05/05 · АВАРІЙНИЙ БУЙ','РІВЕНЬ ПРОЙДЕНО'];
if(status && status.setString)status.setString(a.won?'ПІСЛЯСВІТ · ПЕРШИЙ СИГНАЛ':a.sensorOn?'ПІСЛЯСВІТ · ПРОХІД ВІДКРИТО':'ПІСЛЯСВІТ · ПЕРШИЙ СИГНАЛ');
// ----- 0.6.4 REAL PARALLAX: foreground is blurred and lifted higher -----
// The foreground net stays above Spalakh, but is softened by blur instead of transparency.
// Fixed world positions plus sinusoidal drift. Every environmental sprite is decorative.
// A softer net near Spalakh prevents the foreground from hiding the avatar.
// Pure graphical flare pulse attached to dash start; player body scale never changes.
// Shorter non-intrusive hints, fading after a few seconds of being in the same stage.
// Start ambience only after keyboard interaction (respects browser autoplay rules).
// Audio failure should NEVER interrupt player movement or render the blue error screen.
// Only a NEW SPACE press after reaching the victory state can trigger the change.
// A held jump key will not auto-skip the victory message.

inlineCode: // ПІСЛЯСВІТ 0.8.1 — ABYSS ATMOSPHERE. Dark new parallax, fog, lamp halos; gameplay preserved.
// Ordered as the player encounters them. Each refuge is reachable by a throw from an existing ledge.
for(const nm of ['DepthPlatformLip074','Stone01','Stone02','Stone03','Stone04']) for(const p of objects(nm)) if(p.setOpacity)p.setOpacity(0);
// On death replenish finite world pickups, never duplicate while alive.
// Hanging cargo: 0.38s warning before a lethal fall. Resets after death.
// Buffered jump, coyote time and variable jump height: unchanged from 0.6.6.1.
// World-coordinate closed gate: gameplay blocker is independent of artwork.
// 0.8.4i optical sensors: OFF red -> SCAN blinking amber -> ON solid green.
// Charge uses Spalakh's brightness. Dash and its residual glow allow completion,
// but a nearby, extinguished Spalakh cannot activate either sensor.
// Run, dash or a fading glow can scan; a brighter flare fills faster.
// A second checkpoint after successfully escaping the fish's patrol zone:
// preserves both sensors, resets the consumable world on death, and never soft-locks.
// 0.7.3 — Limited scavenged objects: E = take one nearby, F/Q = throw. No gun or infinite ammo.
// Continuous swept hit test: fast projectiles cannot tunnel through small world targets.
// Our world's defining rule: in darkness Spalakh is a glowing target.
// Throw at an OFF lamp to switch it ON and create an illuminated hiding pool.
// Cargo requires one throw, then shakes for 0.38s before dropping.
// Copper electrical switches open their respective circuit temporarily.
// Dangerous accident: hitting the red alarm panel energizes a new local arc.
// Direct hits interrupt the fish's charge for 2.35 seconds. Fish is not killed.
// Ordinary misses fall onto a solid ledge and make noise at the landing point.
// A missed throw is a distraction if the fish can hear the splash.
worldFeedback('ЛІГВО РИБИ · ШУКАЙ СВІТЛО, АБО ВІДВОЛІКАЙ ЇЇ',s.x,s.y-95);
// 0.7.2 — Fair danger loop: warning -> pursuit -> committed lethal lunge.
// Faster than a sprint in close range; can still be outplayed by dimming, hiding or jumping.
// 0.7.7 — External light provides actual camouflage. Spalakh's self-glow
// still activates optical sensors but must NOT reveal him inside a lit refuge.
// Pool art is 620x620. Enter at 220px, leave at 245px (hysteresis prevents HUD flicker).
// Keep the previously occupied refuge slightly longer at its edge.
worldFeedback('У СВІТЛІ ТЕБЕ НЕ ВИДНО · НЕ ТОРКАЙСЯ РИБИ',s.x,s.y-100);
// In dark water even a dim Spalakh contrasts with the environment.
// Entering light suppresses visual pursuit after a brief last-position search.
// A physically committed LUNGE is not cancelled by cover.
// After 0.55s concealed, pursuit changes to investigation of LAST visible position.
// Never update fishLastX when hidden by lamp light; investigate noises separately.
// Once a lunge begins, direction is committed. Jumping or turning away can evade it.
// Visible chase wind-up lasts about half a second before the charge.
// Even at a lit refuge or among reeds, the fish's BODY is still deadly.
// Static sharp debris: jump over, avoid with elevated platforms.
// Electrified cables: visible flashes, alternating ON/OFF cycle with a safe opening.
// Optional triggered alarm has its own lethal arc, easily avoided by waiting or jumping.
// Camera follows horizontally; vertical camera centers on the 1080px world, keeping all gameplay visible.
// 0.8.3a: seven watercolor parallax planes, seamlessly wrapped every 1280px.
// Screen-anchored peripheral underwater glass. Does not distort gameplay coordinates.
// Press G to compare the scene with/without water glass. HUD is a separate upper layer.
// 0.8.4f — Stable screen-space underwater optics for PixiJS 7 / GDevelop.
// IMPORTANT: Pixi filterArea is a GLOBAL SCREEN rectangle, not camera/world bounds.
// The old (scroll,360,1280,720) rectangle moved away from the viewport and clipped
// most of the room on camera travel. Keep (0,0,viewW,viewH) on the gameplay container.
// HUD is on its own GDevelop layer and remains entirely unfiltered.
if(!container)throw new Error('GDevelop game layer Pixi container unavailable');
// This shader runs on the captured GAMEPLAY scene only, never on the HUD.
// filterArea's x/y never follow the world camera. This is the core fullscreen fix.
// Fully remove GPU filter to compare FPS, restoring any previous layer area.
// 0.8.1: calm drifting local mist in 5 carefully separated pockets, *visual only*.
// Temporary fish and organic light effect.
// 0.8.2.1 ART QUALITY FIX: animated watercolor fish, same AI and physics collider.
// Lure is part of the painted fish: duplicate placeholder lure and unattached halo are disabled.
// 0.8.4i: three readable sensor states. Keep existing game hitboxes and gate logic.
// The same short confirmation click is used in the crab room.
// Older cyan SensorGlow sprites are obsolete with the new amber/green lens halos.
// Character: fixed feet pivot across all 8 animations; only the sprite's opacity and tint fade, not its scale or collision.
// 0.8.4e: universal pivot (192,242). All 42 normalized frames share exact canvas/feet.
// Frame changes never alter character scale, collision geometry or foot position.
// v0.7.9.4: four-second resting fade + low-amplitude breathing after full dim.
// This never changes light refuge detection, player collision, or character scale.
// 0.7.9.4 — SOFT BODY COMET: 40px diffused bloom, body-attached origin and feathered leading edge.
// Procedural PIXI ribbon; no PNGs, particle emitters, smoke blobs or gameplay side effects.
function updateSoftComet0794(runtimeScene, actor, dt, deathCount, dying, won, reset, behindZ) {
// Wide gaussian bloom ≈40px around the broad ribbon; enough padding prevents hard clipping.
// Keep the ribbon sharp and graphic: only soft and aura get blur.

} catch (noFilter) { /* Works without a blur filter. */ }

// Do not connect two places when respawning or teleporting.

// Keep the cross section oriented consistently through reversals/loops.

// No circular sprites: every band is a continuous tapered mesh.
// From diffuse outer bloom to dense gold core. Bands share identical broad geometry.

// 0.8.4e — pixel sparks: 5 crisp RED squares at each jump/dash, born at the TRAIL TIP.
// Physical positions independent of the player. Pixelated on purpose (NO blur/filter).

if(s.dying)goal='СПАЛАХ ЗГАС · ПОВЕРНЕННЯ ДО КОНТРОЛЬНОЇ ТОЧКИ';
goal='НЕБЕЗПЕКА! БІЖИ ДО СВІТЛА · S У ВОДОРОСТЯХ · F КИНЬ ПРЕДМЕТ';
else if(s.x<930)goal='A/D РУХ · SPACE СТРИБОК · SHIFT БІГ · X РИВОК';
else if(s.x<1460&&!s.sensorA)goal='ПОПЕРЕДУ СТРУМ: ДОЧЕКАЙСЯ ПАУЗИ АБО ВЛУЧ У ЩИТ';
if(!firstSafe)goal=s.carried?'F — КИНЬ ПРЕДМЕТ У ЛАМПУ':'E — ПІДБЕРИ ПРЕДМЕТ · F — УВІМКНИ ЛАМПУ';
else goal=s.inLightCover?'ПІДНІМИ ЯСКРАВІСТЬ РУХОМ АБО РИВКОМ X — СЕНСОР A ЧЕКАЄ СЯЙВА':'СЕНСОР A ЗЧИТУЄ ЯСКРАВІСТЬ: НАБЛИЗЬСЯ І СВІТИСЯ';
goal=entrySafe?'СВІТЛО ПОПЕРЕДУ: РИБА НЕ ПОМІЧАЄ ТЕБЕ ВСЕРЕДИНІ':'ПІДБЕРИ ПРЕДМЕТ · УВІМКНИ ЛАМПУ ПЕРЕД ЛІГВОМ';
if(!entrySafe)goal='УВІМКНИ ПЕРШУ ЛАМПУ ЛІГВА · КИДОК F';
else if(s.inLightCover)goal='ТУТ БЕЗПЕЧНО ВІД ПОГЛЯДУ РИБИ · ЧЕКАЙ ПАТРУЛЯ';
else goal='ТЕМРЯВА: СХОВАЙСЯ В ЗАРОСТЯХ (S) АБО ОГЛУШИ РИБУ (F)';
if(!midSafe)goal='ВАНТАЖ НАД ЛІГВОМ: ЗБИЙ ЙОГО АБО ПРОБЕРИСЬ ДО ЛАМПИ';
else goal='ДРУГЕ СВІТЛОВЕ УКРИТТЯ · ПЕРЕХОДЬ ДО СЕНСОРА B';
if(!sensorSafe)goal='ПІДБЕРИ ПРЕДМЕТ · УВІМКНИ ЛАМПУ БІЛЯ СЕНСОРА B';
else if(s.inLightCover)goal='СЕНСОР B: РОЗЖЕНИ СЯЙВО · СТРУМ ВСЕ ЩЕ НЕБЕЗПЕЧНИЙ';
else goal='СЕНСОР B ЗЧИТУЄ ТВОЄ СЯЙВО — РУХАЙСЯ АБО РИВОК X';
}else if(s.gateOpen)goal='ШЛЮЗ ВІДКРИТО · ОМИНИ УЛАМКИ · ЗНАЙДИ МАЯЧОК';
else goal='ЩЕ ОДИН СЕНСОР НЕ АКТИВОВАНО · ПОВЕРНИСЯ ЛІВОРУЧ';
hud('HUDHint',s.worldMessageTimer>0?s.worldMessage:s.coverEntered?'У СВІТЛІ ТЕБЕ НЕ ВИДНО · РИБА ВТРАЧАЄ СЛІД':goal);

// New 0.8.4i fish includes its own lure and halo — hide the legacy glow.
angGlow084.setOpacity(0); // prevent doubled or detached lure

if(s.win){hud('HUDVictory','ГЛИБИНА ПРОЙДЕНА');hud('HUDVictorySub','Я когось шукав...  Сигнал десь нижче.');}
